verdict.rationale: Atlas documents creating, sending, and tracking SAFEs from the Dashboard as part of its fundraising tooling, and it provides legal documents developed with Cooley, so founders don't draft from scratch. Support rests on a single brief doc mention. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the signing/e-signature step, confirmation that the SAFE templates are standard terms (e.g., Cooley/YC-standard), convertible note support, independent or hands-on corroboration of the SAFE workflow.
